title: A random walk approach to high-dimensional critical phenomena
summary: We present a "black box" proof of mean-field near-critical behaviour for a family of functions on $\mathbb Z^d$ (${d>2}$) satisfying a short list of assumptions. The functions represent two-point functions of a lattice statistical mechanical model in the subcritical or critical regimes, and are proved to have decay of the form $|x|^{-d+2+\varepsilon}\exp[-c|x|/ξ]$, for any $\varepsilon>0$.
